app.name: dotenvx
app.one_liner: A secure dotenv tool with end-to-end encryption for managing environment variables across any language or platform.

screens.name: Main CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Provide access to dotenvx commands for managing encrypted environment variables.
primary_actions: Run 'dotenvx run -- <command>' to execute programs with decrypted envs
Use 'dotenvx rotate' to rotate encryption keys and re-encrypt .env files

rust_commands.name: rotate_keys
rust_commands.purpose: Rotate encryption keys and re-encrypt .env files securely.

rust_commands.name: run_with_env
rust_commands.purpose: Execute a command with decrypted environment variables injected.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add key rotation functionality with file overwrite safety checks
week 1: Implement core CLI command parsing
week 1: Integrate decryption logic for .env files
acceptance_tests: Confirm that wrong private key usage results in clear [WRONG_PRIVATE_KEY] error without data corruption
Ensure 'dotenvx run -- node index.js' correctly injects decrypted env vars into the process
Validate that global installation via npm/curl/Homebrew enables cross-language usage
Verify that 'dotenvx rotate' fails gracefully when write permissions are missing on .env file
